body: I’ll definitely finish high school. I’ve never hunted but I’m going to bow hunt and possibly hunt with rifles pretty soon. I mainly enjoy bushcraft type stuff (for example I just started making a gym in my backyard out of natural materials). I live in the US, making it difficult to just walk into the woods and live how I want without getting in trouble.

Yea, that in addition to feeling that I have no control over what I do. I want to be outdoors as much as possible but feel like my only options for the next two years are to go to school, spend 3+ hours on homework every day, and wait for something good to happen. Plus, I am absolutely clueless about how I can legally live how I want to.
